subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the passage in no more than 90 to
guide_solution: Summary Nobody can shine in life without punctuality. So, everybody should be punctual because it is the most valuable thing. A punctual man finds time for more work still. On the other hand, an unpunctual man can not finish his normal duties. Unpunctuality produces such a bad impression on the minds of others. Naturally the western people are punctual. But the people of our country are unpunctual. And they can't do their duties like the western people. We all should be punctual to improve our selves and to develop our country. অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : হযরত আলী (রা) ৬০১ খ্রিস্টাব্দের ২০শে সেপ্টেম্বর মক্কায় জন্মগ্রহণ করেন। তিনি ছিলেন হযরত মোহাম্মদ(স.)-এর চাচাত ভাই ও জামাতা। মহানবী (স.) ছোট বেলায়ই 125 general among my classmates. On the other hand, Sel-fi has become more popular among my classmates. They enjoy this genre. It is 5%. It means they are willing to enjoy this genre. They accept it more than other film genre.
